name: pre-read-shared-reader-out-of-band-change-carries-the-notice
description: The warn-mode counterpart of the out-of-band deny (#278). Session A's first read of CLAUDE.md seeds v1 with A's hash and grants A SHARED; A's next read offers different bytes with the version unchanged and no commit of A's own to explain them. The read is still admitted with hash_differs, and the change is named in a context-only hookSpecificOutput -- no permissionDecision -- because hash_differs is a top-level key the model never sees. Both backends (cohexa-ai/agent-coherence-plugin#205).

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: ⚠ CLAUDE.md on disk differs from v1, the last content committed through the coordinator, and no session committed the change: it was made outside the coordinator. Read CLAUDE.md before relying on it, and do not write it from an earlier read; that write would replace the change.
